_doc: Named camera setups of the Blender lanes (WP-Q7, roadmap 10.1). Distances and heights are in HEAD HEIGHTS of the framed character (camera_setups.HEAD_M), so a setup scales with the cast. thirds = [x, y] of the framed point on the frame, 0..1 from the left / from the bottom; thirds_tol is the allowed miss in frame widths. 'from' = the camera stands behind that subject (over-the-shoulder), 'target' = the subject framed. view: 'bearing' = the camera looks along the shot's bearing, 'along_ab' = from 'from' towards 'target', 'perp_ab' = at right angles to the A-B axis. f-stops are pinned inside the DoF range of the finish round (fstop_min..fstop_max).

establishing_wide.label: establishing wide: the group on the right third, a slow rise on a crane

mcu_front.label: medium close-up, front (J5 dialogue, D-116): B seen from A's side, head and chest, eyes on the upper third; the reverse swaps the subjects

ots_a.label: over A's shoulder onto B: B on the right third, eyes on the upper third

ots_b.label: the reverse of ots_a: over B's shoulder onto A

low_angle_hero_cu.label: low-angle hero close-up: a long lens from knee height, eyes on the upper third, a slow push

push_in_reveal.label: push-in reveal: the subject small on the left third, the camera walks in to a medium shot

profile_two_shot.label: profile two-shot: both in side view, the eye line on the upper third, centred by design
